headline: BlueStone Q3FY27 QTD: Business up 45% YoY
summary: BlueStone Jewellery & Lifestyle reported 45% YoY business growth for Q3FY27 quarter-to-date, driven by festive demand and increased transaction volume.

headline: Morepen launches Desloratadine in US generics market
summary: Morepen Laboratories launched its first prescription generic, Desloratadine Tablets USP, in the US via Morepen Bio Inc. This move extends its API strengths into finished dosage distribution.

headline: Tata Steel UK to break even in Q4FY27
summary: Tata Steel expects its UK operations to nearly break even in Q4FY27 if imported materials are cleared. India operations see stronger H2FY27 performance.

headline: Divi's Labs targets double-digit H2FY27 revenue growth
summary: Divi's Laboratories management has confirmed a double-digit revenue growth outlook for H2FY27, following 17% constant currency growth in H1FY27, without specifying a more precise target.

headline: Gland Pharma appoints Xiao Le as CIO for Singapore unit
summary: Gland Pharma appoints Xiao Le as Chief Investment Officer of its wholly owned subsidiary in Singapore to enhance M&A capabilities across key global markets.

headline: Indian Hotels shares flag large trade on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 7,81,856 Indian Hotels shares changing hands on BSE at ₹894.40, with a combined value of ₹69.93 crore.

headline: SPIC Q2FY27 Results: Net Profit Falls 34% YoY
summary: Southern Petrochemical Industries Corporation reported a standalone net profit of ₹34.96 crore for Q2FY27, down 34% YoY. Revenue rose 22% to ₹999.17 crore, but margins contracted due to higher material costs.

headline: Bombay Cycle & Motor posts ₹58.88 lakh Q2 net profit
summary: Bombay Cycle & Motor Agency reported a standalone net profit of ₹58.88 lakh for Q2FY27, up 81.7% YoY. Consolidated income rose to ₹286.16 lakh.

headline: L&T wins significant contract worth ₹10B-₹25B
summary: Larsen & Toubro has secured a significant contract, with the contract value falling in the range of ₹10 billion to ₹25 billion.

headline: TTK Prestige warns of margin pressure post festive season
summary: TTK Prestige has flagged margin pressures following the end of the festive season, signalling potential challenges ahead for the kitchen appliances maker.

headline: Nihar Info launches digital gold platform
summary: Nihar Info Global Ltd soft-launched GoldnSilver.shop on Diwali, enabling physical and digital gold transactions via SafeGold. ETF integration with Zerodha is targeted for November 2026.

headline: Sai Silks to host virtual investor meet on Nov 11
summary: Sai Silks (Kalamandir) Limited scheduled a virtual investor meet for November 11, 2026, at 11:00 am IST. The session targets individual and institutional investors under SEBI LODR norms.

headline: Anupam Rasayan promoter revises share pledge disclosure
summary: Mona Anandbhai Desai filed a revised SAST disclosure to identify lenders for pledged shares, correcting issuer names and detailing debenture holders.

headline: Neuland Laboratories block trade on NSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 14,536 shares of Neuland Laboratories was executed on the NSE at ₹20,695.00 per share, aggregating to ₹30.08 crore.

headline: Aster DM Quality Care certifies fractional share payouts
summary: Aster DM Quality Care Limited submitted Audit Committee reports certifying the distribution of net sale proceeds from consolidated fractional shares to eligible shareholders of Quality Care India Limited following their amalgamation.

headline: Panchsheel Organics promoters buy 75,000 shares
summary: Three promoter group members acquired 75,000 equity shares of Panchsheel Organics via open market on Nov 6, 2026. Holdings increased for all three individuals.

headline: Starlight Capital buys Trishakti shares
summary: Starlight Capital Private Limited acquired 1,100 equity shares of Trishakti Industries Ltd via open market purchase, increasing its holding to 61,200 shares.

headline: Ajanta Pharma promoter pledges 1 lakh shares
summary: Aayush Agrawal, trustee of Aayush Agrawal Trust, created a pledge on 1,00,000 shares of Ajanta Pharma while releasing 10,25,000 shares due to loan closures.

headline: Gulf Lloyds H1FY27 results: Profit steady, cash burn widens
summary: Gulf Lloyds (India) Ltd reported H1FY27 net profit of ₹194.81 lakh, nearly flat YoY. Revenue rose 6.5% to ₹1,772 lakh, but operating cash flow turned negative at ₹921.54 lakh due to working capital pressure.

headline: LTM to host investor meetings at three major conferences
summary: LTM Limited will participate in investor conferences organized by Avendus Spark, JM Financial, and CLSA in Mumbai from November 16 to 18, 2026.

headline: LWS Knitwear gets second AGM extension from ROC
summary: LWS Knitwear Ltd received a second one-month extension from the Registrar of Companies to hold its FY26 Annual General Meeting, pushing the deadline further.

headline: Gopal Snacks to host analyst meet on Nov 13
summary: Gopal Snacks Limited will hold one-on-one and group meetings with White Oak Capital Asset Management and 360 One Asset Management in Mumbai on November 13, 2026.

headline: Sansera Engineering to host investor meet in Mumbai
summary: Sansera Engineering Limited will participate in an investor conference organized by CLSA on November 16, 2026. The meeting will focus on publicly available information.

headline: Benara Bearings appoints RK Jain Agarwal as auditor
summary: Benara Bearings & Pistons Ltd replaces Agarwal Jain and Gupta with R. K. Jain Agarwal & Co. as statutory auditors for FY27 after term completion.

headline: Anupam Rasayan projects FY27 revenue at ₹4,800-5,000 crore
summary: Company executive states H2 is very strong and acquisitions are consolidated. FY27 revenue guided between ₹4,800 and ₹5,000 crore with 23% margins.

headline: UTI AMC to host investor meet on Nov 16
summary: UTI Asset Management Company will hold a group meeting with analysts and institutional investors on November 16, 2026, in Mumbai. No price-sensitive information will be shared.

headline: Aryaman Financial injects ₹5.00 crore in subsidiary
summary: Aryaman Financial Services Ltd acquired 3,47,500 equity shares of its wholly owned subsidiary Aryaman Finance (India) Ltd for ₹5.00 crore via rights issue.

headline: Hitachi Energy India reschedules Q2FY27 call
summary: Hitachi Energy India Limited has advanced the timing of its Q2FY27 analyst conference call to 5:00 PM IST on November 12, 2026.

headline: Bank of Baroda to attend JM Financial India Xchange 2026
summary: Bank of Baroda representatives will participate in the JM Financial Annual India Conference on November 16, 2026, in Mumbai, engaging with institutional investors.

headline: Master Trust promoter pledges 66.35 lakh shares for subsidiary NCDs
summary: Harneesh Kaur Arora pledged 66,35,000 equity shares of Master Trust Ltd to secure ₹75 crore NCDs issued by wholly owned subsidiary Master Capital Services Ltd.

headline: Trent schedules analyst meetings Nov 17-26
summary: Trent Limited has disclosed its schedule for analyst and institutional investor meetings from November 17 to 26, 2026, including one-on-one sessions with global asset managers.

headline: HMT Ltd Q2FY27 Results Approved
summary: HMT Ltd board approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Details available on company website.

headline: ICICI Bank schedules investor meets for Nov 16-19
summary: ICICI Bank Ltd will participate in seven investor meetings from November 16 to 19, 2026. Events include CITIC CLSA and Morgan Stanley forums.

headline: Gujarat Fluorochemicals to attend investor conferences
summary: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Limited representatives will participate in two major investor conferences in Mumbai on November 16 and 17, 2026. The company will share its Q2FY26 results presentation.

headline: HB Portfolio Q2FY27 Results: H1 Profit Jumps 104%
summary: HB Portfolio Ltd reported a 104% YoY rise in consolidated net profit for H1FY27. The board also approved the re-appointment of Anil Goyal as MD for five years.

headline: Torrent Pharma redeems ₹100 crore NCDs
summary: Torrent Pharmaceuticals redeemed ₹100 crore in unlisted secured redeemable non-convertible debentures on November 9, 2026, as per the repayment schedule.

headline: Knowledge Marine raises topline guidance to 80%
summary: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works has raised its topline guidance sharply from 35-40% to 80%, signalling a significant upgrade in its revenue growth outlook.

headline: SML Mahindra production up 13.5% in Oct
summary: SML Mahindra reported 1,369 units produced in October 2026, a 13.5% rise YoY. Sales dipped to 958 units while exports surged 67% to 107 units.

headline: Kothari Industrial acquires 30% stake in PKFPL
summary: Kothari Industrial Corporation acquired 4.5 crore shares in Phoenix Kothari Footwear for ₹45 crore, raising its stake to 30%. The target entity reported nil turnover for FY26.

headline: Airfloa Rail to host H1FY27 earnings call
summary: Airfloa Rail Technology Ltd will hold a virtual investor call on November 16, 2026, to discuss un-audited standalone and consolidated results for the half year ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Lirilamma TS acquires 4.38% in Geetanjali Credit
summary: Lirilamma T.S. acquired 193,481 shares of Geetanjali Credit and Capital Ltd via open market and off-market purchases on November 6, 2026.

stock_name: R M DRIP AND SPRINKLERS SYSTEM
headline: RM Drip Q2 EBITDA falls to 47M rupees vs 83M YoY
summary: RM Drip & Sprinklers System reported Q2 EBITDA of 47M rupees, down from 83M rupees YoY. EBITDA margin contracted to 14.52% from 27% in the same period last year.

headline: Aurobindo Pharma to host investor meet on Nov 16
summary: Aurobindo Pharma officials will participate in one-on-one and group meetings at the JM Financial India Xchange 2026 conference in Mumbai on November 16, 2026.

headline: Camlin promoter pledges 10.8 lakh shares for margin
summary: Camlin Fine Sciences promoter Ashish Subhash Dandekar pledged 10.8 lakh shares to SKS Fincap and Ashika Global Securities to cover security shortfalls.

headline: Rajnish Wellness opens four Dava Discount outlets in West Bengal
summary: Rajnish Wellness Limited expanded its Dava Discount franchise network by opening four new medical retail outlets in West Bengal. The move aims to enhance affordable healthcare access.

headline: ITC shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 6,29,685 ITC shares changing hands at ₹278.15 on NSE, with a combined value of ₹17.51 crore.

headline: Titan schedules investor meet for Nov 18
summary: Titan Company plans a group meeting with Marcellus and IMCO on November 18, 2026. No price-sensitive info will be shared during the session.

headline: Veegaland Developers appoints Dr. George Sleeba as WTD
summary: Veegaland Developers Ltd appointed Dr. George Sleeba as Whole-time Director and accepted the resignation of Mr. Kurian Thomas, effective November 9, 2026.
